title: A landing retried after gh pr create failed pushes a second branch
body:
## Summary
After `gh pr create` fails (the branch is already pushed), resume + drive re-runs landRun from scratch: freeName skips the pushed branch and pushes `article/<slug>-2`, orphaning the first on the remote.

## Description
lib/articles/registryWrite.ts:263-432 landRun has no continuation: run.landing records branch and commit on pr-failed (lib/articles/landing.ts:224), resumePoint returns `approved` (lib/articles/resume.ts:12), and land() calls landRun with nothing of that record. hitl-approval anatomy: 'approved work re-runs from scratch' is the Continuation defect. Fixed looks like: when run.landing.commit exists and origin holds run.landing.branch at that commit, skip to the PR step (or re-use the branch), and remove the kept worktree.

## Flow
- approve -> land -> push ok -> gh pr create exits 1 -> status failed, landing.branch=article/x
- resume -> drive -> landRun -> freeName sees article/x taken -> article/x-2 pushed -> PR opened from x-2
- fix: landRun(input.previous?) reuses branch+commit when present and identical; probe asserts origin holds 1 article/* branch after the retry

## Expected impact
5

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - one approved post, one pushed branch
Before: 2 origin branches after one failed PR + retry (scratch probe on the article sandbox: ['refs/heads/article/a-stub-post-about-tokens','refs/heads/article/a-stub-post-about-tokens-2'])
After: predicted 1
Method: probe - measured Before on the stub registry; After not built (M, two files)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: scratch probe: STUB_GH_FAIL=1 drive -> 'landing: gh pr create failed; the branch article/a-stub-post-about-tokens is pushed'; unset, resumeRun + driveRun -> landed on article/a-stub-post-about-tokens-2
instrument: articles-engine probe: STUB_GH_FAIL=1 drive, unset, resumeRun+driveRun, count origin refs/heads/article/* (=2 today)

title: A browser that cannot launch fails a human-approved landing
body:
## Summary
renderFigurePngs/renderTablePngs (lib/articles/mediumPackage.ts:315,363) let chromium.launch() throw, so land() fails before landRun, while a figure that fails to render is only logged.

## Description
land() (lib/articles/landing.ts:204-205) tolerates per-figure failure (`failedFigures` logged) but a launch failure is an exception and the approved run goes to failed. The registry copy carries no PNGs (README text), the Medium draft is made at the gate, and the check's rendered half already degrades to not-measured on the same condition (lib/articles/checksRendered.ts:80). Fixed: a launch failure returns every figure as failed.

## Flow
- approve on a box whose Playwright browser is missing -> land -> buildMediumPackage -> chromium.launch throws -> status failed 'landing: browserType.launch...'
- fix: catch the launch, return { written: [], failed: names }

## Expected impact
3

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - the landing's outcome rests on the registry gates, not on a PNG render
Before: launch failure -> landing failed (by reading; not reproduced)
After: predicted landed with failedFigures named
Method: simulation - no seam to make launch fail inside the probe lane
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: an injectable launcher parameter on renderFigurePngs/renderTablePngs, driven by a probe whose launcher throws

title: The check's quorum counts receipts; the round's quorum counts review files
body:
## Summary
reviewRound closes a round on review files (lib/articles/critiqueReviews.ts:96-97); critiqueCheckItem counts receipts with outcome completed (lib/articles/critique.ts:367). A crash between the review write and the receipt write makes them disagree.

## Description
reviewOnce writes reviews/<id>.json then receipts/<id>.json; a resume never re-runs a reviewer whose review exists, so that reviewer keeps no receipt: the round closes, summarizeCritique omits it and the check item reports one fewer completed - a quorum the step passed can fail at the gate. Fixed: one count, from one artefact, in both places (or write the receipt first).

## Flow
- seed round-1 with 2 reviews + 1 completed receipt, minCompleted 2
- reviewRound would close; critiqueCheckItem fails 'round 1: 1 of N reviewers completed'

## Expected impact
3

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one quorum rule
Before: two counts over two artefacts
After: predicted one
Method: simulation - crash window not reproduced in the round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: probe over a seeded critique/ dir: review present, receipt missing; compare reviewRound's completed with critiqueCheckItem

title: The approval record binds to no version of the post
body:
## Summary
approveRun records only {at, patches} (lib/articles/humanActs.ts:30); land() reads post/ from disk whenever it runs, including a resume after a failed landing.

## Description
hitl-approval decision-records: 'Approval binds to what was approved. If the gated content changes after the verdict, the approval is void.' No hash of post/ (or of the check report the Board showed) is kept, and no actor. Today nothing in the pipeline writes post/ after approval, so the gap is only reachable by hand edits between a failed landing and its resume - which is exactly how an operator repairs a red registry gate.

## Flow
- approve -> landing fails at the registry gate -> post files edited -> resume -> lands the edited post under the old approval

## Expected impact
4

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the landed post is the approved post
Before: approval holds no digest
After: approval holds a digest; land refuses a mismatch
Method: simulation - walked the failed-landing resume path
Result: better
Gate: direction
